z_independent.mechanism: flat T^3 slices have zero intrinsic curvature

isotropic_impossibility.statement: Isotropic Einstein cores on T^3 require Ric(q_0) = -2g_0, impossible by Preissmann (abelian pi_1, no sec < 0).
isotropic_impossibility.consequence: All viable cores must have nonzero initial traceless shape
